title: Ashur-danin-pal
summary: Son of Shalmaneser III of Assyria, coregent with his father; CFAH takes him as the first Sardanapalus of the chroniclers.
description: Son of Shalmaneser III of Assyria, coregent with his father; CFAH takes him as the first Sardanapalus of the chroniclers. Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 5: The Babylonian Dynasties of Berossus," ARJ 16 (2023): 635–670, section "Sardanapalus"
reign.note: Coregent with Shalmaneser III. The AP-43 section gives the end as his death in 824 B.C. (open question I6).

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 5: The Babylonian Dynasties of Berossus," ARJ 16 (2023): 635–670, section "AP-43: Conclusions for Dynasty 6: 1232–706 B.C."
reign.note: Second statement in the same paper (open question I6).
